title: Introducing Basedash in English, Español, Français, and Português
summary: Choose English, Español, Français, or Português in profile settings and the Basedash interface switches instantly, with no page reload.
body_markdown:
Today we’re launching Basedash in **Español, Français, and Português** . Alongside English, you can now use Basedash in the language you work in.


Choose your language in profile settings and the entire interface switches instantly. There is no page reload, no new session, and no need to find your place again.


Four languages. One fast interface.


## Work with your data in your language


The language around your data should not get in the way of understanding it. Basedash now brings English, Spanish, French, and Portuguese to the interface across dashboards, chats, automations, navigation, and settings.


That means a teammate can open a dashboard in Español, review a chat in Français, or configure an automation in Português while working in the same Basedash workspace. The data and workflows stay where they are; the interface around them uses the language each person selected.


## Switch languages, not pages


Changing your language takes a few seconds:


1. Open your profile settings
2. Select **English** , **Español** , **Français** , or **Português**
3. Keep working on the same screen


The change happens immediately, without reloading the page. Your dashboard, conversation, or settings screen stays open while the navigation, controls, and interface copy update around it.


You can switch back at any time. Reviewing a translated product flow, sharing a screen with a teammate, or simply working in your preferred language no longer means interrupting what you were doing.


## Only your selected language loads


Adding more languages should not make the app feel heavier. Basedash loads only the language you choose instead of making everyone download every translation.


The result is the same snappy Basedash experience in all four languages. Switching is immediate, and the app stays focused on the interface you actually use.


## Built for multilingual teams


Language is a personal preference, even inside one workspace. A team in Montréal might work across English and Français. A company in Lisbon might collaborate with teammates who prefer Português or Español. Each person can choose the interface that feels natural without changing how the rest of the team works.


This is our first step toward making Basedash useful to more teams in more places, while keeping the product as fast and direct as it is today.


## Getting started


Basedash is available in all four languages today.


1. [Sign up for Basedash](https://charts.basedash.com/signup) or log in
2. Open your profile settings
3. Choose **English** , **Español** , **Français** , or **Português**
4. Continue working without a page reload


**Work with your data in your language.**
